Healthy.name: Healthy leaf
Healthy.prevention: Keep up regular watering, spacing and monitoring.

Early_Blight.name: Early Blight
Early_Blight.symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings, starting on older leaves.
Early_Blight.treatment: Remove infected leaves; apply a copper or chlorothalonil fungicide.
Early_Blight.prevention: Rotate crops, mulch, avoid wetting leaves, space plants.

Late_Blight.name: Late Blight
Late_Blight.symptoms: Large dark water-soaked patches, white mold underneath in humid weather.
Late_Blight.treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants quickly; use a recommended fungicide.
Late_Blight.prevention: Use resistant varieties, improve airflow, avoid overhead watering.

Leaf_Mold.name: Leaf Mold
Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale yellow spots on top, olive-grey mold underneath.
Leaf_Mold.treatment: Reduce humidity, remove affected leaves, apply a fungicide.
Leaf_Mold.prevention: Ventilate greenhouses, space plants, use resistant varieties.

Septoria_Leaf_Spot.name: Septoria Leaf Spot
Septoria_Leaf_Spot.symptoms: Many small round spots with grey centres and dark borders.
Septoria_Leaf_Spot.treatment: Remove lower infected leaves; apply a copper or chlorothalonil fungicide.
Septoria_Leaf_Spot.prevention: Rotate crops, mulch, water at the base, clear plant debris.

Bacterial_Spot.name: Bacterial Spot
Bacterial_Spot.symptoms: Small dark greasy spots, sometimes with yellow halos.
Bacterial_Spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves; copper sprays can slow spread.
Bacterial_Spot.prevention: Use disease-free seed, avoid overhead watering, rotate crops.

Target_Spot.name: Target Spot
Target_Spot.symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings and a yellow edge.
Target_Spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves; apply a suitable fungicide.
Target_Spot.prevention: Improve airflow, avoid leaf wetness, rotate crops.

Spider_Mites.name: Two-spotted Spider Mites
Spider_Mites.symptoms: Tiny yellow speckles, fine webbing, bronzed leaves.
Spider_Mites.treatment: Spray with water, insecticidal soap or neem oil; use miticides if severe.
Spider_Mites.prevention: Keep plants well watered, avoid dust and stress, encourage natural predators.

TYLCV.name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
TYLCV.symptoms: Upward leaf curling, yellowing, stunted growth.
TYLCV.treatment: No cure: remove and destroy infected plants; control whiteflies.
TYLCV.prevention: Use resistant varieties, insect nets, yellow sticky traps.
